description: What can I use instead of tool X? Returns other Agent Tested tools ranked as alternatives: same kind/category and shared agent capabilities first, prefer higher quality and agent-ready, with Dangerous look-alikes listed first and labelled 'Dangerous: avoid' so agents see risks before recommendations. Excludes the queried tool. Soft suggestions (did_you_mean, isError false) when the slug is unknown. Use get_tool on a pick for the full report.

kind.description: Optional: only return alternatives of this kind.

slug.description: Tool slug from search_tools/get_tool, or a name that slugifies to one. Repo paths and near-misses are resolved the same way as get_tool.

name: list_alternatives
title: List alternatives to a tool
